# 4. Favorite flow chart

 
@fig-chart shows my decision process for determining whether I am sleepy.
```{mermaid}
%%| label: fig-chart
%%| fig-cap: A simple flowchart for deciding if you are sleepy.
graph LR
     A{Are you sleepy?} -->|Yes| B[Drink a coffee ]

  C -->|Yes| B
  B --> D{Still sleepy?}
  D -->|Yes| E[Go to sleep]

```
